original.statement: The UseStrimziPodSets feature gate is deprecated; environments upgrading from Strimzi 0.34 or older must enable it and use StrimziPodSet resources before upgrading.

corrected.statement: Before upgrading from Strimzi 0.34 or older with the Kafka operand, operators must make sure the UseStrimziPodSets feature gate is enabled and StrimziPodSet resources are used.

decision.reason: [ev-0fe6816db4bb] does not say the UseStrimziPodSets feature gate is deprecated. It describes a step operators must take before upgrading from Strimzi 0.34 or older with the Kafka operand: enable the UseStrimziPodSets feature gate and make sure StrimziPodSet resources are used. So the subject is a migration step and the change is migration-required, not a feature-gate deprecation.
